question: Can RAKL represent and evaluate whether a scientific conclusion is robust to a preregistered envelope of assumption violations without treating robustness as proof that the assumptions are true or silently selecting favorable perturbations after seeing the result?

formal_object.robust_positive: all valid registered scenarios remain above +delta_material
formal_object.robust_negative: all valid registered scenarios remain below -delta_material
formal_object.sensitive: registered scenarios cross conclusion class or material boundary
formal_object.partially_identified: some scenarios cannot be evaluated or the admissible assumption envelope itself is not point specified

authority_boundary: robustness is relative to the registered assumption envelope
robustness does not prove assumptions true or mechanism identified
sensitivity can lower decision/claim authority even when the baseline model fits
a scenario that changes population/QoI is a new contextual chart, not an assumption perturbation of the same claim
main_falsifier: If assumption-sensitivity conclusions are unstable to arbitrary analyst-chosen scenario envelopes, the method must report the envelope itself as an identification object rather than a robust conclusion.
